caller_sample.bootstrap_method: bias-corrected percentile bootstrap: resample the 13 sampled units with replacement, 2000 draws, numpy default_rng([20261114, 2]); within-sample noise only (serial correlation of one short window not modelled)
caller_sample.hhi_external_meaning: deposit-source concentration (external predecessors: bridge token-contract callbacks, direct callers); not solver concentration
caller_sample.classification_note: system and intents.near self-receipts excluded from external shares; *.omft.near / *.omni.hot.tg = bridge token contracts; *.ai.near / *.agent.near = AI agents BY NAME SUFFIX ONLY (escrow.ai.near is a plain account with no contract; the label is a heuristic, not a verified classification); 64-hex / 0x40-hex = implicit accounts; a predecessor whose receipt is ft_on_transfer is a NEP-141 token contract and is reported as bridge_relayer. execute_intents fills are relayer self-receipts (predecessor intents.near) and never enter the external HHI; solver concentration is in solver_concentration

solver_concentration.bootstrap_method: bias-corrected percentile block bootstrap by page: resample the 8 page strata (p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8) with replacement, every unit of a drawn page enters together (98 units), 2000 draws, numpy default_rng([20261114, 1]); keeps within-page serial correlation, so the interval reflects between-page variation

settlement_hub.rule: hub = account with the most distinct transfer counterparties (>= 10 and >= 2x the runner-up); a hub leg = one transfer intent from a solver to the hub; solver = known from the atomic structure rule, name pattern, or >= 2 legs each way with the hub and no withdrawal intent

solver_concentration.method: fill participation = (a) the solver side of an atomic execute_intents fill (>= 2 token_diff signers; solver = pure token_diff signer when the counterparty bundles a withdrawal, else a signer whose name matches (*solver*, *-liq*, market maker) or that the structure rule identified elsewhere in the sample, else the named account facing an implicit 1Click deposit address), or (b) a transfer intent from a solver to the settlement hub (see settlement_hub.rule); HHI over participations per solver account; transfers that are not solver-to-hub legs are inventory or user moves, not fills. hhi_solver_ci90 is a bias-corrected bootstrap (bootstrap_method): a block bootstrap by NearBlocks page when the sample is stratified in time (bootstrap_resampling = block_by_page), else over sampled units

sample.note: solver audit = execute_intents receipts from the caller pages plus NearBlocks' method-filtered list (?method=execute_intents), de-duplicated by receipt id. design stratified_time_sample: page 1 is the newest page; pages 2..K are reached by jumping NearBlocks' id cursor to even time offsets back to target_span_s (cursor aimed with the measured ids-per-second slope), so the sample is K short windows (~45 s each) spread over hours, not one contiguous window; coverage_share = summed page windows / total span. Caller-page receipts are assigned to stratum p1 (same newest window). hhi_solver_ci90 resamples whole pages (block bootstrap)

confidential_boundary.basis: Treasury NEP-245 balances in intents.near priced with the live 1Click token list; flows are balance differences priced at today's prices. Boundary flow is not swap volume; 24h flows are lower bounds.

svrn_glidepath_months.justification: QUANT_PIPELINE_SPEC and TERMINAL_UI_SPEC model the 2.5% -> 1.6% cut as a linear 24-month (730-day) glidepath; the proposal itself does not fix the phasing.

kb_per_agent_vault.justification: A NEAR account with a few access keys and small contract state costs 5-50 KB; at storage_amount_per_byte = 1e19 yocto 20 KB locks 0.2 NEAR per agent vault.

public_volume_growth_yoy.justification: EXPECTED (mean) public-volume growth: the volume GBM carries the Ito drift ln(1+g) - sigma^2/2 per month, so E[V_t] = V_0 (1+g)^(t/12) and 30% YoY is the growth of the MEAN path (= the deterministic path); the Monte Carlo MEDIAN path is lower by exp(-sigma^2 t/2) at the measured monthly sigma (see sotp.calibration.gbm_convention and volume_terminal_median_usd_day). Default 30% is set well below the trailing-1y DefiLlama near-intents volume growth, which included incentive-driven months (NEAR@3.33); the slider range spans decay to -20% and 2.5x growth.

competitive_fee_ceiling_bps.justification: median over cross-VM cells of the best competitor's friction (per-venue medians: Relay 3.0 bps (n=3) binding, LI.FI 25.0 bps (n=3) not binding); the lowest-friction venue polled is the binding ceiling, a higher venue fee is not; depends on the venue set and clips polled, not an observed fee schedule; the level a public take-rate cannot exceed long-run

regimes.label: SVRN glidepath (2.50% -> 1.60% linear over 24 months, then flat)

public_volume_growth_yoy.justification: EXPECTED (mean) public-volume growth: the volume GBM carries the Ito drift ln(1+g) - sigma^2/2 per month, so E[V_t] = V_0 (1+g)^(t/12) and 30% YoY is the growth of the MEAN path (= the deterministic path); the Monte Carlo MEDIAN path is lower by exp(-sigma^2 t/2) at the measured monthly sigma (see sotp.calibration.gbm_convention and volume_terminal_median_usd_day). Default 30% is set well below the trailing-1y DefiLlama near-intents volume growth, which included incentive-driven months (NEAR@3.33); the slider range spans decay to -20% and 2.5x growth.

confidential_share_target.justification: nearstats intents.totalsBreakdown shows confidential ~39% of 30d volume (derived as NEAR total minus public); 40% holds the mix flat rather than extrapolating growth.

confidential_take_bps.justification: QUANT_PIPELINE_SPEC's institutional MEV-protected shard fee band is 15-25 bps; 20 is the midpoint and no live confidential fee series exists to verify it.

fee_compression_lambda_monthly.justification: Monthly mean-reversion speed of the public take toward the competitive floor; 3%/month is a ~23-month half-life, in line with bridge-fee compression observed across Across/Relay since 2023.

confidential_compression_divisor.justification: MODEL_DESIGN section 4.2 sets lambda_conf = lambda / 3: confidential execution competes on privacy rather than price, so fees compress slower than public routing.

discount_rate.justification: 25% is a venture-stage crypto hurdle rate; Dragonfly / Electric Capital style memos use 20-30% for pre-maturity protocol cash flows.

terminal_multiple_floor.justification: Guardrail on the live peer-median FDV/revenue multiple: 8x is roughly a mature L1 fee multiple floor; clipping is logged in SotpValuation.calibration.

terminal_multiple_cap.justification: Guardrail so a single high-multiple peer (ETH/SOL trade above 100x revenue on DefiLlama) cannot drive the terminal value; 60x caps the peer median.

confidential_multiple_haircut.justification: nearstats flags intents.protocolMetrics.confidentialTvlUsd as sourceStatus 'unverified'; a 30% haircut on Engine 2's terminal multiple prices that verification risk.

buyback_capture_ratio_override.justification: -1 means use the live DefiLlama near-intents dailyHoldersRevenue / fees capture ratio (~35%, reconciles with revenue.near.org); any value in [0, 1] overrides it for slider scenarios.

near_price_drift_annual.justification: Zero drift: the model does not forecast NEAR price to value the token; price enters only to convert USD buybacks into NEAR units (MODEL_DESIGN section 4.2).

tau_floor_bps.justification: max(0.5 bps, min(live public take, live cross-VM headroom)) from the execution benchmark (headroom_by_archetype_bps.cross_vm = 1.47 bps).

tau_pub_start_bps.justification: reconciled: (gross_fees_30d - V_conf_30d x tau_conf / 1e4) / V_pub_30d; blended live gross take 14.96 bps (DefiLlama daily fees / daily volume summed over the aligned take-rate window: aligned daily charts, 30 complete UTC days 2026-10-11..2026-11-09).

terminal_multiple.justification: peer median FDV / annualized revenue ex-NEAR (n = 3), clipped to [8, 60]; raw 2336.1x.

engines.method: PV of H months of public holder revenue (V_pub x tau_pub x alpha) at the discount rate, plus year-3 annualized revenue x peer-median FDV/revenue multiple, discounted; tau_pub reverts to the benchmark floor.

engines.label: Engine 2: confidential execution franchise (dark-pool holder revenue)
engines.method: Same construction on confidential volume at the assumed confidential take; terminal multiple x confidential_multiple_haircut because nearstats flags confidential TVL as unverified. NOT MEASURED this run: the nearstats public/confidential split failed the plausibility guard; the starting confidential share is the registry assumption confidential_share (40%), so this engine values an assumed volume, not a measured one.

engines.label: Engine 3: monetary / supply-sink premium (gas burn + state-lock demand flow)
engines.method: PV of L1 gas burn (grown with public volume) at the peer multiple plus the discounted market value of newly state-locked NEAR (sum state_lock_t x P_t): a demand-flow proxy, not a cash flow.

crossover_month_distribution.basis: first month whose net float change (issuance - buyback - gas burn - state lock) <= 0
crossover_month_distribution.note: Path probabilities reflect the dispersion of the volume and price GBMs (a path crosses when holder revenue / price outruns issuance); compare with deterministic_crossover_month (the expected-volume path) and with supply_physics.breakeven_daily_volume_usd before quoting a crossover.

sensitivity_heatmap.basis: held constant for the horizon; alpha folded into the net take; regime svrn_glidepath

calibration.take_basis: tau = gross fees / volume (bps); alpha = holders revenue / fees; holder revenue = V x tau x alpha
calibration.take_rate_window: aligned daily charts, 30 complete UTC days 2026-10-11..2026-11-09
calibration.take_rate_window_note: ONE canonical window from intents_forensics.fees (last 30 complete UTC days common to the DefiLlama fees, revenue and volume daily charts); gross_take_bps / net_take_bps / capture_ratio / volume_30d_usd are consumed, not recomputed
calibration.confidential_share_source: assumption: registry confidential_share = 40% (nearstats split implausible; not a measurement)
calibration.gbm_convention: mean-matching (Ito): log V_t = log V_0 + t (ln(1+g) - sigma^2/2) + sigma W_t, so E[V_t] = V_0 (1+g)^t; public_volume_growth_yoy is the EXPECTED (mean) growth and equals the deterministic path; the MEDIAN simulated path is lower by exp(-sigma^2 t/2) (see volume_terminal_median_usd_day vs volume_terminal_mean_usd_day); the price GBM uses the same convention (zero drift => E[P_t] = P_0)
calibration.current_fdv_basis: spot price x on-chain total_supply at the snapshot block
calibration.terminal_multiple_basis: peer median FDV / annualized revenue ex-NEAR (n = 3), clipped to [8, 60]
calibration.sigma_volume_source: measured: monthly log-return sigma of 30-day volume aggregates
calibration.price_basis: fdv / (S_0 + gross issuance - buybacks - gas burn - state lock at H, svrn_glidepath trajectory)
calibration.crossover_basis: first month whose net float change (issuance - buyback - gas burn - state lock) <= 0

sotp: peer median FDV/revenue 2336.1x clipped to 60.0x (guardrails [8, 60])
calibration.mc_mean_fdv_note: mean over paths; exceeds the P50 by lognormal convexity (mean-matching GBM: the deterministic path is the EXPECTED volume path, the P50 path sits below it, see gbm_convention) and is not a base case
calibration.engine_percentiles_note: engine percentiles are taken per engine over paths and are NOT additive: the P50s of the three engines do not sum to the total P50; engine_shares_on_median_total_path is the additive decomposition of the one path whose total is the sample median

scenarios.title: Aggregator bypass: public take races to 1 pip
scenarios.narrative: Third-party frontends route around near.com and the public gross take collapses from 11.6 bps to 0.01 bps (the bare intents.near contract fee); confidential execution reprices from 20 bps to 5 bps. Capture ratio alpha is held at 33%, so the hit is price, not allocation. Deterministic (median-input) FDV -79.6% to $160.3M; implied price $0.12. Evidence against it: live cross-VM headroom is +1.5 bps, so a bypassing frontend must first give up that execution edge. Trigger: DefiLlama 30d net take (gross x alpha) below 3.0 bps (now 4.9 bps).
scenarios.monitor_field: sum(dailyRevenue chart) / sum(summary/dexs/near-intents chart) x 1e4 over the same 30 complete UTC days
scenarios.fdv_basis: deterministic (median-input) SOTP at perturbed inputs; not the Monte Carlo P50

scenarios.title: Governance stalemate: 2.5% issuance forever
scenarios.narrative: Validators never enact the SVRN cut: max_inflation_rate stays at 2.50% for the full horizon instead of gliding to 1.60%. Protocol cash flows do not change, so FDV moves +0.0%; the damage is dilution: 24,582,505 more NEAR outstanding at the horizon and a per-token value of $0.56 (-1.8% vs base). Net-float crossover: none within horizon (base: none within horizon). This scenario is live today: the on-chain cap reads 2.50% and no cut has been enacted.
scenarios.trigger_note: breached while the on-chain cap exceeds the SVRN target: the cut has not been enacted
scenarios.fdv_basis: deterministic (median-input) SOTP at perturbed inputs; not the Monte Carlo P50

scenarios.title: Post-incentive volume decay (NEAR@3.33 unwind)
scenarios.narrative: Mercenary liquidity from the NEAR@3.33 incentive program unwinds: public daily volume $74.6M -> $29.8M (-60%), confidential $49.7M -> $14.9M (-70%) and confidential TVL x0.3 (nearstats flags that TVL unverified). Take rates are unchanged, so revenue falls with volume and the deterministic (median-input) FDV -60.7% to $308.5M; implied price $0.23. Current 30d volume $3.73B is 77% of the 30d record $4.84B; the trigger fires at -40%.
scenarios.fdv_basis: deterministic (median-input) SOTP at perturbed inputs; not the Monte Carlo P50

scenarios.title: Solver cartelization: HHI_solver > 3,500, 1Click loses the spread
scenarios.narrative: Two market makers take most fills (HHI_solver > 3,500) and spreads widen until Relay/LI.FI deliver 2 bps better net execution on cross-VM (headroom -2 bps). Keeping flow costs the same 2 bps of take (11.6 bps -> 9.6 bps) while compression runs at 0.15/month. Deterministic (median-input) FDV -28.6% to $559.5M; implied price $0.41. Live: HHI over solver fill participations 4,577 (2.2 effective solvers across 104 fill participations), bootstrap 90% CI [3,932, 5,135]; deposit-source HHI over external predecessors 3,491 (not a solver measure); cross-VM headroom +1.5 bps; trigger at HHI_solver > 3,500 or headroom < 0.
scenarios.monitor_field: HHI over solver fill participations decoded from execute_intents args.signed[].payload.message (NEP-413 signer_id, token_diff legs); secondary: headroom_by_archetype_bps.cross_vm (destination units)
scenarios.trigger_note: sample: 104 solver fill participations over 15,152 s; HHI_solver 4,577, bootstrap 90% CI [3,932, 5,135] (CI lower bound 3,932 > 3,500: breached); deposit-source HHI over external predecessors (bridge callbacks, direct callers; not solvers) = 3,491
scenarios.fdv_basis: deterministic (median-input) SOTP at perturbed inputs; not the Monte Carlo P50

bear_case.falsification_summary: fee_race_to_zero: public gross take at 0.01 bps and confidential at 5 bps puts the deterministic FDV at $160.3M (-79.6%); watch DefiLlama near-intents 30d net take weekly, trigger < 3.0 bps, now 4.9 bps (not breached). governance_stalemate: no SVRN cut (cap 2.50% for 36 months) leaves the deterministic FDV at $783.9M (+0.0%) but dilutes per-token value to $0.56 (-1.8%) with crossover none within horizon; watch max_inflation_rate in EXPERIMENTAL_protocol_config, trigger > 1.60%, now 2.50% (BREACHED). post_incentive_decay: public volume -60% and confidential -70% puts the deterministic FDV at $308.5M (-60.7%); watch nearstats 30d volume against its 30d record weekly, trigger <= -40%, now -22.9% (not breached). solver_cartelization: HHI_solver > 3,500 with cross-VM headroom at -2 bps puts the deterministic FDV at $559.5M (-28.6%); watch the execute_intents solver HHI (now 4,577) and the live quote-race headroom (now +1.5 bps) weekly (BREACHED). All four at once: deterministic FDV $90.0M (-88.5% vs base $783.9M); 2 of 4 measured triggers currently breached, and the thesis is falsified if any trigger holds for 30 consecutive days.
bear_case.value_basis: deterministic at median inputs; not a Monte Carlo percentile
bear_case.basis: base_fdv_p50 / sotp_fdv_p50 / combined_worst_fdv keep their field names for compatibility but are DETERMINISTIC (median-input) FDVs from deterministic_sotp, not Monte Carlo percentiles; mc_* fields carry the seeded MC medians when computed

stress_parameters.justification: 1 pip is the bare intents.near contract fee once third-party frontends route around near.com and its 25 bps / 10-20 bps partner fees (QUANT_PIPELINE_SPEC Model C.1, MODEL_DESIGN 4.3.1).
Confidential execution repriced to 5 bps, a quarter of the 20 bps default, once public routing is free (MODEL_DESIGN 4.3.1).
Early warning: DefiLlama near-intents 30d net take below 3 bps (live ~5.6 bps class) means compression is already past the mid-point to zero (MODEL_DESIGN 4.3.1).
Public volume -60%: QUANT_PIPELINE_SPEC Model C.3 sizes the NEAR@3.33 mercenary-liquidity unwind at -60% of 30d volume.
Confidential volume -70%: the shard's TVL is flagged unverified by nearstats, so its volume is assumed more incentive-dependent than public flow (MODEL_DESIGN 4.3.3).
Early warning: 30d volume more than 40% below the 30d record (nearstats records.max30dUsd) (MODEL_DESIGN 4.3.3).
HHI 3,500 is two actors at ~40% each plus a tail; the US horizontal-merger guideline calls > 2,500 highly concentrated (QUANT_PIPELINE_SPEC Model C.4).
Cartel spreads widen until Relay/LI.FI deliver 2 bps better net execution on cross-VM; 1Click must give the same 2 bps of take back to keep flow (MODEL_DESIGN 4.3.4).
Floor on the cartel scenario's public take give-back: max(0.5 bps, live public take - 2 bps) (MODEL_DESIGN 4.2 competitive floor).
Compression speed set to the registry's high bound for fee_compression_lambda_monthly (0.15/month): losing the spread means order flow leaves at the fastest plausible rate.

assumptions.justification: SVRN governance proposal to cut the protocol max_inflation_rate from 2.5% to 1.6%; not enacted on-chain (live EXPERIMENTAL_protocol_config.max_inflation_rate is still [1, 40]).
QUANT_PIPELINE_SPEC and TERMINAL_UI_SPEC model the 2.5% -> 1.6% cut as a linear 24-month (730-day) glidepath; the proposal itself does not fix the phasing.

EXPECTED (mean) public-volume growth: the volume GBM carries the Ito drift ln(1+g) - sigma^2/2 per month, so E[V_t] = V_0 (1+g)^(t/12) and 30% YoY is the growth of the MEAN path (= the deterministic path); the Monte Carlo MEDIAN path is lower by exp(-sigma^2 t/2) at the measured monthly sigma (see sotp.calibration.gbm_convention and volume_terminal_median_usd_day). Default 30% is set well below the trailing-1y DefiLlama near-intents volume growth, which included incentive-driven months (NEAR@3.33); the slider range spans decay to -20% and 2.5x growth.
nearstats intents.totalsBreakdown shows confidential ~39% of 30d volume (derived as NEAR total minus public); 40% holds the mix flat rather than extrapolating growth.
QUANT_PIPELINE_SPEC's institutional MEV-protected shard fee band is 15-25 bps; 20 is the midpoint and no live confidential fee series exists to verify it.
Monthly mean-reversion speed of the public take toward the competitive floor; 3%/month is a ~23-month half-life, in line with bridge-fee compression observed across Across/Relay since 2023.
MODEL_DESIGN section 4.2 sets lambda_conf = lambda / 3: confidential execution competes on privacy rather than price, so fees compress slower than public routing.
25% is a venture-stage crypto hurdle rate; Dragonfly / Electric Capital style memos use 20-30% for pre-maturity protocol cash flows.
Guardrail on the live peer-median FDV/revenue multiple: 8x is roughly a mature L1 fee multiple floor; clipping is logged in SotpValuation.calibration.
Guardrail so a single high-multiple peer (ETH/SOL trade above 100x revenue on DefiLlama) cannot drive the terminal value; 60x caps the peer median.

Used ONLY when the live peer FDV/revenue median AND the FDV/fees median are both null (CoinGecko outage / 429): 30x is the midpoint of listed-exchange and L1 REV multiples (roughly 8x mature L1 fee multiples to 60x the guardrail cap); the run records a warning, calibration.terminal_multiple_source = 'assumption' and Engine 1 is flagged assumption-heavy. Never used when a live multiple exists.

Used ONLY when both price series (nearstats price-history 1y and the coins.llama.fi daily chart) are unavailable: 100% annualized volatility is the centre of the 60-160% band large-cap alt-L1 tokens have realized over 1y windows; the run records a warning and sotp.inputs.sigma_price_annual is labeled source 'assumption'.

Used ONLY when the DefiLlama near-intents dexs chart is unavailable and neither volume_monthly_sigma nor volume_daily_sigma could be measured (the 30-day volume itself then comes from nearstats): 0.35 is the class of the measured monthly log-return sigma of 30-day volume aggregates (0.27-0.36 across windows in the committed snapshots); the run records a warning and sotp.inputs.sigma_volume_monthly is labeled source 'assumption'. A chart outage never exits the run.
nearstats flags intents.protocolMetrics.confidentialTvlUsd as sourceStatus 'unverified'; a 30% haircut on Engine 2's terminal multiple prices that verification risk.
A NEAR account with a few access keys and small contract state costs 5-50 KB; at storage_amount_per_byte = 1e19 yocto 20 KB locks 0.2 NEAR per agent vault.
Used ONLY if the archival measurement of storage growth fails; default 0 gives no credit to the sink and the run records a warning rather than inventing a number.
-1 means use the live DefiLlama near-intents dailyHoldersRevenue / fees capture ratio (~35%, reconciles with revenue.near.org); any value in [0, 1] overrides it for slider scenarios.
Zero drift: the model does not forecast NEAR price to value the token; price enters only to convert USD buybacks into NEAR units (MODEL_DESIGN section 4.2).

MODEL_DESIGN 4.2 hard floor for the public take: tau_floor = max(this, min(live public take, live cross-VM headroom)). It is the floor on its own only when the execution benchmark did not run, and the run then records a warning.

Multiplier on the confidential-volume GBM sigma applied while nearstats flags confidentialTvlUsd as unverified (MODEL_DESIGN 4.2). Default 1.0 = no widening, because no measured dispersion factor exists; Engine 2 stays assumption_heavy regardless.

Tornado range for measured Intents ratios (gross take, holder capture): min..max over this many trailing non-overlapping 30-day windows of the DefiLlama daily series. Six windows covers the period since the 2026-02-23 buyback start; earlier windows mix a different revenue regime.

Tornado range (+/- this fraction of the measured value) for live inputs that have no measured dispersion in the snapshot (L1 gas burn, state-lock growth, cross-VM headroom). A labeled width, not a confidence interval.

FALLBACK ONLY, used when the live nearstats public/confidential split is implausible (intents_forensics.volume.confidential_share_status = implausible_fallback). The last plausible split, nearstats totalsBreakdown as of 2026-10-31, read $1.58B confidential of $3.86B 30d (40.9%); from the 2026-11-07 split onward the explorer public tile equals the NEAR total and confidential all-time volume reads $0 while confidential TVL is ~$143M, i.e. a source change, not a measurement. Range: the bear preset target (15%) to confidential_share_target's high bound (60%).

A reported confidential 30d share below 1% is treated as a broken split (not a measurement) when nearstats' own payload contradicts it: confidential TVL > 0 with ~zero all-time confidential volume, the confidential stream reporting ok, or a split check whose detail says the split is withheld. With ~$140M of confidential TVL a <1% share would mean the shard turns over less than ~0.3x its TVL per month.

Minimum wall-clock span of the solver sample before the cartelization trigger may grade HHI_solver breached or clear. The method-filtered execute_intents pages and settlement-hub legs typically cover a window of minutes; fills inside a 2-minute window are serially correlated (the same solvers quote consecutive blocks), and the bootstrap CI resamples only within that window, so it measures within-window noise, not how concentration varies across hours. One hour is the shortest span that spans several quoting cycles; the range runs from 15 minutes to one day.

Number of method-filtered NearBlocks execute_intents pages (50 receipts each) in the stratified solver sample: the newest page plus pages placed at even time offsets back to solver_sample_target_span_s. Each page is one block of the page-block bootstrap, so more pages tighten the HHI_solver CI. Unauthenticated NearBlocks served 5 solver calls after the caller walk and refused the 6th (HTTP 429, 2026-11-08), so the walk runs in chunks of 5 one rate window apart: 6 to 10 pages cost the same single extra ~62 s window, and 8 = 5 + 3 leaves headroom in the second window. ~400 receipts spread over hours versus the 4 contiguous pages (~3 minutes) used before.

Target time depth of the deepest solver-sample page (6 h), reached by jumping NearBlocks' id cursor rather than walking page=N (page >= 2 without a cursor answered HTTP 520 after 50 s on 2026-11-08). Deeper cursors cost latency: 1.4 s at ~5 h, 2.0 s at ~11 h, 14 s at ~41 h, 40 s at ~7 days (measured 2026-11-08). 6 h is 6x the solver_sample_min_span_s floor, so a misaimed cursor still clears it, and spans the Asia/Europe/US session hand-offs inside one run; the range runs from the 1 h minimum to 12 h (latency still ~2 s).

Scorecard threshold: a flow share (confidential volume, AI-agent-labeled receipts) is called 'material' at >= 10% of the measured total; below it the claim is graded NOT_SUPPORTED. A conventional materiality line, not a fitted value.

findings: NEAR trades at 67x annualised fees versus a peer median of 252x (rank 2 of 4, lowest first; inside the peer range); on revenue it is 199x versus 2,336x (inside the peer range).
0 of 3 peers trade at or below the model's 60x terminal FDV/revenue multiple; NEAR itself trades at 199x.
At the peer FDV/fees distribution, NEAR's $70M of annualised fees maps to $11.08B-$45.38B (median $17.60B, n = 3) against a $4.71B market FDV; a relative-value cross-check, not a fair value.
NEAR issues $117M a year to validators and delegators (2.5% of FDV) against $70M of annualised fees and $24M of holder revenue (gas burn + Intents buyback): revenue covers 20% of the security budget.
At 2.5% inflation stakers earn 5.63% nominal and 3.61% real including buybacks; non-stakers lose 2.03% a year to dilution net of buybacks.
relative_value.caveat: Peer 'revenue' follows each chain's own DefiLlama methodology (peers[].revenue_methodology), so revenue multiples compare different cash-flow definitions; with n = 3 peers the median is a reference point, not a distribution.
